prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create FROM SCRATCH one 2D inventory relic icon that fits directly into Slay the Spire 2's existing relic atlas. Subject: Junna's Burning Gem, ONE irregular emerald-green stone with a small painted fire rising behind it. Completely redraw the artwork in the native reference style.
Inputs 1-4 are ACTUAL NATIVE SLAY THE SPIRE 2 RELIC ICONS and are the primary STYLE authority. Image 1 Burning Blood shows the intended flat red-orange flame with a small mustard-yellow center and thick black border. Image 2 Charon's Ashes shows simple hand-painted flame tongues. Image 3 Brimstone shows chunky mineral planes and rough matte paint. Image 4 Philosopher's Stone shows how faceted stone is actually painted in this game: broad muted solid faces, rough brush edges, a heavy dark contour, very sparing edge highlights.
Input 5 is the original anime SHAPE reference only. Use the exposed irregular protruding gemstone above the gray wrapped sword grip; omit the grip completely. The gemstone shape should be a compact lumpy angular fragment with one off-center blunt peak, a notched side and uneven lower edge. One connected stone, no separate crystal cluster.
Design:
- Large green gemstone is the main object, about 75% of the icon's visual mass. Draw a squat three-quarter chunky silhouette with 7-10 broad irregular polygon faces. Forest-green shadow planes, muted medium emerald faces and a couple of pale sage-green dry-brush edge marks. Broad readable planes, no tiny triangular facet web.
- Behind its upper edge place a SMALL connected fire of 3-4 simple irregular red-orange tongues, with a single warm ochre/mustard-yellow core. The fire is an opaque hand-painted cartoon shape like the fire in native Burning Blood or Charon's Ashes. It rises above the gem and peeks past one shoulder, occupying at most the upper quarter of the whole silhouette. Do not wrap the whole gemstone in a ring of fire.
- Both stone and flame share the native relic icons' heavy near-black, slightly irregular brush contour; internal dark planes clearly separate the material. Muted, compact palette. Flat painted/cel-like color patches and a little dry-brush roughness. Keep the same chunky brush character and small-scale clarity as the supplied game icons.
Composition: one compact standalone relic centered on square TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha, occupies 75-80% canvas height with clear margins. This is the final icon art, not a presentation sheet.
Strictly exclude: bloom, glowing aura, emitted light haze, luminous rims, rim lighting, neon colors, white-hot flame core, lens flares, sparkles, particles, photorealistic fire, smooth airbrush gradients, glossy jewel reflections, glass refraction, elaborate flame ribbons, full circular fire wreath. Also no base, mount, holder, gold metal, sword, handle, text, labels, background, floor shadow or frame.
The key is an ordinary native Slay the Spire hand-painted item with a tiny painted fire, with the visual restraint of the actual atlas references.
